title: Get FASTER ON iRacing OVALS! | iRacing Track Guide | Homestead Miami GEN 6

corners.label: T1
corners.line: get car guided close to white line
corners.exit: get back on gas, hold on for dear life

corners.label: T2
corners.exit: round off exit, try not to get too close to outside wall

corners.label: T3
corners.braking: lift off gas, trail brake down at bottom
corners.exit: let car roll slightly longer before getting back on gas

general_tips: run around the seam on the outside
keep car turning at steady radius using seam as reference
get as much momentum as you can as you cross the line
Carry as much speed as possible using the shortest distance around the corner.
Hang out around the inside and conserve your tires for the late stages of the green flag run.
Be careful when using the outside lane as tires could burn up quickly.
Maintain track position by considering the inside or outside lane based on tire condition and track position.
